title: "Bioelectricity: a bridge between physics and cognition, by way of biology" by Michael Levin
excerpt: This is a ~22 minute talk that I gave remotely at the Tech For Impact Summit 2025 in Japan (https://tech4impactsummit.com/).  It goes very quickly over the idea of bioelectricity as the cognitive glue between different scales of intelligence at the body, allowing top-down control
